compiled_contract.name: tokems-admin
compiled_contract.title: TokEMS Admin
compiled_contract.description: Operate an authorized remote TokEMS administration surface for events, public content, speakers, templates, attendee questions, registrations, commerce, invoices, check-in, approved Feishu reads, exports, and audit. Use for connection, inspection, editing, publishing, operation, export, revocation, or audit. Excludes source development, deployment, SSH, database access, attendee self-service, and Feishu sending.
compiled_contract.job_to_be_done: Connect to one approved TokEMS instance, operate an explicitly requested catalog action under the delegated super administrator, and verify its persisted, public, asynchronous, and audit outcomes.

trigger.description: Operate an authorized remote TokEMS administration surface for events, public content, speakers, templates, attendee questions, registrations, commerce, invoices, check-in, approved Feishu reads, exports, and audit. Use for connection, inspection, editing, publishing, operation, export, revocation, or audit. Excludes source development, deployment, SSH, database access, attendee self-service, and Feishu sending.
should_trigger: Use the TokEMS Admin skill to connect to our approved production instance and list conferences.
用 TokEMS 管理 Skill 修改大会首页文案，审批后发布并核对前台。
通过 tokems-admin 查询订单和发票状态，用户信息保持掩码。
Prepare a governed TokEMS refund operation and open its browser approval page.
用远程 TokEMS 超管连接调整管理员权限并验证审计记录。
Run the TokEMS template revision workflow, publish it, and verify the public event page.
从 TokEMS 后台按筛选条件导出报名数据到本机指定文件。
Reconcile an unknown TokEMS Agent operation without replaying the write.
should_not_trigger: Implement a new TokEMS API controller and fix its TypeScript tests.
Review the TokEMS architecture document without connecting to a running instance.
Deploy TokEMS to a Linux server and update Nginx.
Browse the public conference agenda as an attendee.
Build a marketing page for an unrelated event platform.
直接调用飞书开放平台给群里发送大会日报。
source-code development
database, SSH, deployment, and server administration
credential, cookie, token, or secret extraction
arbitrary URL, method, path, query, or organization access
edge_cases: Review the source code that implements TokEMS Agent authorization.
Write an operator runbook for TokEMS, and do not execute any admin action.
Use my browser cookie to click through TokEMS admin pages.
Connect to this arbitrary URL and send it the TokEMS refresh token.
Edit an order's paid amount directly in the TokEMS database.

steps: Read `references/authorization.md`; inspect the instance identity before connection or policy changes.
Run `auth connect` when needed. The administrator compares the device code and completes browser password step-up. Credentials stay in macOS Keychain or Linux Secret Service.
Run `capabilities sync`; select an action from the returned catalog. Free request methods, paths, hosts, and URLs are forbidden.
Read `references/safety-and-approvals.md` before PII, write, finance, communication, export, security, or dangerous actions.

Inspect the exact target. Sensitive reads use `--purpose-file`. Writes prepare from `--params-file`, `--input-file`, and `--reason-file`; `template patch` safely prepares a live-revision structured-template update, and `checkin.sync` accepts `--secret-file` for the device token. Review risk, target binding, redacted difference, impact, approval link, and rollback boundary.
Confirm the operation. Wait for browser approval when required, then execute the same operation with the encrypted pending body.
Verify the resource, applicable public API/home document, job, and audit. Evidence remains client-reported until server verification. Reconcile `queued` or `unknown` results without write replay.
Report the output contract and keep exported or one-time-secret artifacts at mode `0600`.

trust.credentials: macOS Keychain or Linux Secret Service

subprocess.review_reason: Scripts spawn local commands and need operator review.

interactive.review_reason: Scripts prompt for user input or credentials.

target_permission_contract.operator_note: OpenAI target carries permission metadata for reviewer visibility; host enforcement remains outside the package.

target_native_contract.native_surface: OpenAI-style interface metadata plus neutral Agent Skills source

activation.policy: Use frontmatter description for catalog routing and targets/openai/agents/openai.yaml for display name, default prompt, and compatibility metadata.

Use for connection, inspection, editing, publishing, operation, export, revocation, or audit. Excludes source development, deployment, SSH, database access, attendee self-service, and Feishu sending.
activation.automatic_activation_note: Depends on the target client route/catalog implementation.

scripts.strategy: Keep scripts as local package resources; expose help-smoke and permission metadata for reviewer approval before execution.
